Up to $200/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~30 hours each; you set your own schedule.

Why Tosca?

At Tosca, we’re united by a bold purpose: to reduce waste and build a more sustainable world. Our reusable packaging solutions help retailers and suppliers create more efficient and eco-friendly supply chains.

We foster a people-first, collaborative culture where passion, innovation, and appreciation thrive. Here, you’re not just doing a job—you’re making a measurable impact. We support our team members with opportunities for personal and professional growth, and a workplace where great people do meaningful work together.

What You'll Do:

As the National Accounts Manager – Retail, you will lead efforts to transform retail supply chains by driving the shift from traditional corrugated packaging to Tosca’s sustainable Reusable Plastic Containers (RPCs). You’ll develop and strengthen relationships with key retail partners—from the C-suite to distribution centers—serving as a trusted advisor and strategic partner.

In this high-impact role, you will influence decision-makers, uncover growth opportunities, and drive adoption of RPCs across complex retail networks. You’ll manage and expand strategic accounts, lead new business initiatives, and collaborate across multiple departments to deliver solutions that generate long-term value.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for key retail partners, building strong relationships across functions and levels—from distribution centers to corporate leadership.
  • Influence retailers to adopt Tosca’s Reusable Plastic Containers (RPCs) by demonstrating the value of sustainable packaging across their supply chain.
  • Partner closely with Tosca’s Protein, Produce, Egg, and New Business Development teams to support supplier engagement and ensure alignment with retailers.
  • Lead initial RFP efforts and ongoing contract maintenance negotiations to maximize EBITA.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities by securing trials and managing pilots that demonstrate RPC impact on efficiency and sustainability.
  • Support the conversion of goods shipped to retailers from traditional single-use packaging to Tosca’s RPCs, ensuring buy-in from both retailer and supplier partners.
  • Build and maintain detailed account plans for retail partners, aligning strategies with revenue goals and Tosca’s sustainability mission.
  • Conduct supply chain and cost analyses to build compelling value propositions and support decision-making at the retail level.
  • Maintain a healthy pipeline of retailer-driven opportunities and ensure continuous progress toward adoption milestones.
  • Travel as needed to meet with retail stakeholders, support pilot programs, and drive in-person engagement.

What We Are Looking For:

Preferred Qualifications:

raw.excerpt: The roleAt its core this is a hands on senior media buying role.
raw.description:
The role

At its core this is a hands on senior media buying role. You work with live campaigns, make daily decisions using real performance data, and stay accountable for profitable execution.

The second dimension is what makes it unusual. Your campaign judgment helps us evaluate and improve AI agents that support media buying decisions. You will turn real campaign situations into reliable ground truth, review agent recommendations against outcomes, and decide when the system has earned more autonomy. You do not need to be an ML engineer. You do need strong buying judgment, data fluency, curiosity about AI, and the ability to explain why a campaign decision is right.

What you will do

  • Launch, monitor and own internal paid media campaigns end to end.
  • Make hands on scale, hold, optimize and stop decisions across live campaigns.
  • Track spend, conversion rate, CPA, CPL, CPI, CPS, revenue and absolute profit.
  • Work across performance and affiliate economics, with attention to offer, geo, audience, creative and platform differences.
  • Document clear rationales for important decisions so they become useful learning signals.
  • Review AI agent recommendations against real outcomes and identify errors, blind spots and unsafe actions.
  • Maintain realistic evaluation scenarios, golden sets and ground truth labels.
  • Work daily with the engineering team to translate business reality into measurable requirements.

What we are looking for

  • At least5 years hands on performance marketing, user acquisition or affiliate media buying.
  • Strong practical experience with paid social, particularlyMeta and TikTok.
  • Strong understanding of CPA, CPL, CPI and CPS campaign economics.
  • A record of making good decisions with imperfect data and explaining the reasoning clearly.
  • Strong data fluency. You can read distributions, investigate anomalies and separate signal from noise. SQL familiarity is highly valued.
  • Comfortable working directly with engineers and turning operational problems into clear rules and acceptance criteria.
  • Fluent professional English.
  • Based in Europe, with reliable daily working overlap with the team.
  • Hands on operating discipline. This role is for someone who wants to stay close to campaigns, not manage them through reports only.

Nice to have

  • Affiliate networks, tracking platforms, MMPs, fraud signals or offer level optimization.
  • Quality assurance, experimentation, structured evaluation or annotation processes.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, golden sets, judge models, prompt testing or human in the loop systems.
  • Experience hiring or managing media buyers, analysts or a small quality team.

What success looks like

In the first 90 days you take ownership of the internal campaign operating cadence, build a strong working loop with the engineering team, and establish reliable ground truth from live campaign decisions. Within six months you help expand the number of campaigns one person can supervise safely as the AI agents improve, while keeping quality, profitability and human control visible.

Why Mobidea

  • A recognized affiliate and performance marketing brand with real operating experience and campaign flow.
  • Shape a new media buying AI project at an early stage, using live campaigns rather than theoretical demos.
  • Keep doing the media buying work you know while building a rare skill set at the intersection of performance marketing, data and AI.
  • Direct access to the founder and the AI engineering team, with real influence over how the system operates.

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and relationship-focused Customer Success Manager to support and strengthen our relationships with existing B2B customers.

This is a customer success and account management role focused on customer retention, satisfaction, and long-term account growth. Rather than closing sales, you'll build trusted relationships, conduct regular customer check-ins, identify new business opportunities, and collaborate with the Sales team to ensure customers receive the best possible experience.

The ideal candidate has experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Client Services and enjoys building strong client relationships while uncovering opportunities that help customers grow.

Responsibilities

Customer Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned portfolio of existing customer accounts.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers through regular communication.
  • Conduct proactive customer check-ins via phone, email, and virtual meetings.
  • Ensure customers remain satisfied with services and address concerns before they become issues.
  • Identify and escalate potential retention risks.

Account Growth Support

  • Engage customers in consultative conversations to understand their business needs and future plans.
  • Identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional products and services.
  • Document qualified opportunities and hand them over to the Sales team for follow-up.

Customer Success & Internal Coordination

  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback with internal teams.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Engineering, Operations, and Support teams to resolve customer issues.
  • Support onboarding follow-ups and maintain ongoing customer engagement.
  • Ensure customers receive timely updates and support throughout their journey.

CRM & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate customer records, account notes, and activity logs in the CRM.
  • Track account health, renewals, and service updates.
  • Provide customer insights and trends to leadership.
  • Ensure all customer interactions are documented accurately.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Services, Relationship Management, or a similar customer-facing role.
  • Experience managing relationships with B2B customers.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Comfortable making proactive outbound calls to existing customers.
  • Strong consultative communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating across multiple teams.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in telecommunications, wireless, internet services, managed services, or technology industries.
  • Experience supporting geographically distributed customer accounts.
  • Understanding of B2B technology or connectivity solutions.
  • Previous experience working with U.S.-based customers.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Customer Retention Rate
  • Customer Satisfaction
  • Qualified Upsell & Cross-Sell Opportunities Identified
  • CRM Data Accuracy
  • Customer Engagement
  • Account Health

Interview Process

  1. Initial Recruiter Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

What happens after you apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video, completed once on your own time, and it’s the final step that completes your application.

Here’s why we do it this way. Instead of repeating yourself on screening call after screening call, you tell your story once and it carries forward. Hiring managers get to see how you actually communicate before you meet, so when you’re a fit, the first conversation isn’t starting from scratch. Fewer interviews, and the ones you do have count for more.

Don’t overthink it. Record it as many times as you like—nobody sees the takes you discard. Just be yourself. Your Intro Video invitation will come from Spark Hire, our trusted video interview platform, so please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for the email.

Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

You'll own a portfolio of 4-6 CPG accounts, primarily beauty, personal care, wellness, or food and beverage brands. You will serve as the primary strategic partner for your clients on a day-to-day basis, owning the narrative around performance, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring all marketing efforts ladder up to business objectives. A successful candidate is a strong cross-channel marketer and communicator who can confidently translate data into insights, guide internal teams, and build trust with clients. This is a critical role in ensuring accounts are not only running efficiently, but driving meaningful business impact.

As an Associate Account Director (AAD), you will act as the day-to-day strategic lead for CPG clients, ensuring marketing efforts are aligned to revenue growth across DTC, retail, and Amazon ecosystems—not just individual channel performance. You will work closely with client stakeholders across eCommerce, retail, and brand teams, helping navigate tradeoffs between channels, product launches, and campaign strategy. This role requires comfort discussing channel mix, retail dynamics, Amazon performance, and omnichannel measurement. You’ll partner with Project Managers to ensure execution stays on track, while collaborating with the Account Director to refine quarterly strategy and long-term growth plans.

Responsibilities:

  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
  • Lead weekly client calls on larger accounts; support PM-led calls on smaller accounts — own the performance narrative either way
  • Translate Power Circuit roadmap outputs into weekly account priorities; flag when execution is drifting from the strategy
  • Track performance across DTC, retail media, and Amazon ecosystems; identify cross-channel dynamics and surface insights to the client and AD
  • Coordinate paid, SEO, content, influencer, and creative teams around a unified account strategy
  • Advise on channel mix and investment allocation across DTC, retail, and Amazon; flag when channels are cannibalizing rather than reinforcing each other
  • Support the AD on quarterly strategy, renewal prep, and service expansion conversations
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships; contribute to ≥90% retention across your accounts
  • Work in Iris and nova daily; use performance data to surface issues before clients raise them; maintain Pulse cadence at 100%

Role Requirements:

  • 4–7 years in CPG, eCommerce, or retail marketing, with experience managing client relationships day-to-day
  • Familiar with the CPG channel landscape: DTC, retail media, and Amazon basics — ASIN architecture, sponsored vs. organic, retail partner dynamics
  • Understands omnichannel measurement at a working level — knows what MMM and incrementality testing are and when they matter
  • Cross-channel fluency across paid, SEO, content, and influencer — you don't need to be an expert in all of them, but you need to know when something's off
  • Comfortable presenting to director and VP-level stakeholders, including brand-strong clients who have opinions that predate the data
  • Strong written and verbal communication; can translate complex channel dynamics into a clear client narrative

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
  • Net MRR across portfolio
  • Client NPS (8+ avg)
  • Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
  • Power Circuit Certification (annual)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Team Coaching and Development
  • Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
  • Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one

raw.title: Lead Bioinformatician/Engineer (Pipelines and Infrastructure)
raw.excerpt: Natera is seeking a Lead Bioinformatics Engineer to own pipeline and infrastructure engineering for a research informatics team working on cell-free DNA (cfDNA) screening in Women's and Organ Health.
raw.description:
Natera is seeking a Lead Bioinformatics Engineer to own pipeline and infrastructure engineering for a research informatics team working on cell-free DNA (cfDNA) screening in Women's and Organ Health. This is an individual contributor role.

You will own our WDL workflows, the transition toward Nextflow, the AWS infrastructure the team runs on, and the tooling around them. You will inherit a working system from the person who built it, and with them still on the team to teach you.

Our workflows leave clear wins available in cost and runtime for whoever takes them on. Getting scientists to the point where they process their own samples end to end, without an engineer in the loop, is a major thrust of this role.

Primary Responsibilities:

Workflow and Pipeline Engineering: Maintain and improve our WDL workflows on AWS Batch and AWS HealthOmics. Own how new Nextflow workflows and existing WDL workflows run on one set of tooling and infrastructure. Make pipelines easier for scientists to run correctly without engineering support.

Infrastructure and Operability: Own the team's AWS infrastructure, managed as code in Terraform. Improve reliability, reproducibility, and observability across our compute environments. Build testing, monitoring, and alerting that surface failures before a scientist finds them.

Tooling and Developer Productivity: Build and harden internal tooling that reduces manual work for the team, including support for triage of production issues. Make new capabilities easier to test, document, and hand off.

Ways of Working: Use coding agents as a routine part of engineering here, for implementation, code review, investigation, and operational triage. You own what you ship regardless of what produced it, which means reviewing and testing agent-written code to the same standard as your own, and helping the team decide which of these tools are worth adopting.

Collaboration and Handoff: Partner with the team's science leads and data scientists on getting new methods into production pipelines and providing first line review of their changes, and with the production organization on handoff readiness for capabilities moving out of research.

What success looks like after a year:

  • You own the team's pipelines and infrastructure without supervision.
  • Transition to new workflows on the same tooling and infrastructure from our existing workflows.
  • Scientists run and debug their own pipeline work without coming to you first.
  • Operational interruptions to the team's scientific work are down.
  • Agent-assisted work is a normal part of how you work.

Qualifications:

  • Degree in Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Computational Biology, or a related field. A degree is not a requirement: equivalent depth built through work counts fully.
  • 4+ years of software or pipeline engineering experience, preferably in a life sciences, sequencing, or production-adjacent setting. We count relevant experience from the point your work became substantially independent, however you got there.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a system end to end. We mean operating it in production, not only building the first version.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

What we are screening for

  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, including testing and debugging practice.
  • Experience with at least one workflow system: Snakemake, CWL, WDL, Nextflow, or similar.
  • Real cloud experience, ideally AWS, including managing infrastructure as code. Terraform is what we use; another tool is fine.
  • Solid Linux, container, and version control practice.
  • You have built at least one AI-assisted workflow you still use, and you can say what it replaced and how you know it works.
  • A track record of picking up unfamiliar tools quickly, more than any specific tool on your resume.
  • Clear written communication, including documentation someone else can act on.

Strong candidates may also have

  • Direct WDL or Nextflow experience.
  • Familiarity with AWS Batch or HealthOmics.
  • Enough scientific curiosity to understand the biology behind the pipeline and ask useful questions about it.
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$130,900—$163,600 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

raw.excerpt: We're hiring a growth Product Manager to own the buyer side of InPost's ecommerce marketplace – acquisition, activation, retention.
raw.description:
We're hiring a growth Product Manager to own the buyer side of InPost's ecommerce marketplace – acquisition, activation, retention.

Millions of people in Europe already receive parcels through InPost. Far fewer of them start their shopping with us. Closing that gap is the job. You'll own the buyer funnel end to end: how we communicate the USP, how first-time buyers get onboarded, what makes them come back for a second order, and where they drop off in between.

This is an experimentation role, not a spec-writing role. You'll run a high-velocity test pipeline with engineering, design and data, and use what you learn to argue for bigger bets. You'll also work inside a two-sided marketplace, so buyer-side wins have to hold up against seller-side incentives — that tension is part of the work, not a distraction from it.

What you'll do:

  • Own activation, conversion and retention metrics for the buyer funnel including the targets.
  • Run experimentation as a pipeline: hypothesis, sizing, test, analysis, rollout or kill. Weekly cadence, not quarterly.
  • Hunt friction across USP communication, awareness, activation, engagement, discovery and onboarding and remove it.
  • Turn funnel analysis into roadmap bets, and build the case for the expensive ones with evidence.
  • Work directly with marketing and commercial teams on demand generation and offer mechanics..
  • Balance buyer incentives against seller economics, and be explicit about the trade-off you're making.
  • Ship, measure, and say out loud when something didn't work.

What you'll need

  • 3+ years in product management, ideally growth, marketplace or ecommerce.
  • Real experience running experiments - you can explain how you sized a test, what you did about an inconclusive result, and a hypothesis of yours that turned out to be wrong.
  • Fluency in funnel analytics. You pull your own numbers and don't outsource your judgement to a dashboard.
  • A working model of two-sided marketplace dynamics.
  • Bias toward shipping and measuring over perfecting.
  • Experience where growth work is close to commercial operations, not just to marketing.
  • Ability to hold a position with stakeholders when the data supports it.
  • Polish and English, fluent.

Not a fit if

  • You want a stable roadmap defined by someone else.
  • You measure your impact in features shipped.
  • You'd rather run one perfect launch than twenty imperfect tests.

What we offer

  • A funnel with millions of users at the top of it and clear room to improve.
  • Ownership of metrics, budget-relevant decisions and the roadmap for your area.
  • Engineering, design and analytics partners you work with directly, not through a queue.
  • Access to challenging projects and innovative technologies.
  • B2B contract, remote within Poland, flexible hours.

InPost has revolutionised e-commerce parcel delivery in Poland and is now one of Europe’s leading out-of-home (OOH) e-commerce enablement platforms. Founded in 1999 by Rafał Brzoska, InPost provides delivery services through a network of over 64,000 Automated Parcel Machines (APMs) and more than 30,000 pick-up and drop-off (PUDO) points across nine European countries: Poland, the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg, alongside to-door courier and fulfilment services for ecommerce merchants.

InPost’s extensive OOH network supports rapidly growing parcel volumes across its markets, with 1.4 billion parcels delivered in 2025. Its locker solutions offer consumers a delivery option that is cheaper, more flexible and convenient, environmentally friendly and contactless. As a leading OOH logistics provider, InPost is recognized for transforming parcel delivery economics in Europe, appealing to both consumers and merchants through its flexible, technology-driven solutions.

Postmedia is a Canadian news media company representing more than 110 brands across multiple print, online and mobile platforms. Award-winning journalists and innovative product development teams bring engaging content to millions of people every week whenever and wherever they want it.

This exceptional content, reach and scope offer advertisers and marketers compelling solutions to effectively reach target audiences. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

The Opportunity:

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading the strategic planning and execution of complex, cross-functional initiatives that drive organizational growth and operational excellence. Projects may include mergers and acquisitions, IT initiatives (such as infrastructure, networking, financial technology, application implementations and upgrades), multi-vendor system integrations, regulatory and administrative process improvements, and product-related initiatives.

In this role, the Senior Project Manager oversees the full project lifecycle, from initiation through implementation and completion. Responsibilities include developing project plans, coordinating cross-functional teams and external vendors, managing budgets and timelines, mitigating risks, facilitating project governance, and providing regular status updates and executive-level reporting. The role ensures projects are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with business objectives.

The ideal candidate is an experienced project management professional with a proven ability to lead large, complex initiatives across multiple teams. They possess strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, along with hands-on experience delivering IT and/or fintech projects. Success in this role requires a collaborative approach, sound business judgment, and the ability to influence and deliver results in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead all aspects of assigned projects from initiation, planning, solutioning/end-state design, execution, testing, and successful delivery of assigned project scope
  • Manage initiatives across all involved parties: external vendors, internal departments including but not limited to: Information Technology, Finance, Product, Editorial, Operations, Sales, Subscription Services team, and Marketing.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to create project documentation including, but not limited to: project scope, requirements, decisions, process-design, assumptions, milestones, etc.
  • Monitor project performance, identify risks, assumptions, issues, and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Provide regular updates to senior leadership and stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment.
  • Lead and mentor multi-disciplinary teams throughout the project lifecycle, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to the evolution of project management practices and PMO maturity through documentation, knowledge sharing, and process optimization.
  • Deliver insights and recommendations that enhance client service and support data-driven decision-making.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Information Technology, or a related field; PMP certification strongly preferred.
  • Minimum 7+ years of progressive experience in project and program management, including leadership of cross-functional initiatives.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with a track record of meeting deadlines and managing competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Analytical mindset with experience interpreting data and identifying trends to inform strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams, coach others, and foster collaboration across departments.

Compensation:

Employment offers presented to the selected candidate are based on a combination of qualifications, experience, responsibilities of the role and the candidate's location. Base Salary: $85,000 - $105,000

Vietnamese AI Product Evaluator

🎯 The Project

Productive Playhouse is building a talent pool of Vietnamese speakers for an upcoming project testing and evaluating leading AI chatbots. The objective is to enhance response quality through direct user interaction with the various AI models.

Open to freelancers based outside the U.S.

This is more than one job. Apply once, and we'll keep you in mind for this project — and future ones that need your language skills.

The Details

We’re looking for independent contractor engagement (task-based - project-based).

  • Pay Rate: $9.00 USD per hour
  • You choose which tasks to take, set your own hours, and are free to work with other clients any time. You can stay flexible as the project evolves.
  • This is an iterative project, work arrives in batches (there may be pauses between them).

What You’ll Do

As an AI Evaluator, you'll play a critical role in shaping and improving the next generation of Generative AI. You'll participate in structured, hands-on evaluations by interacting directly with various AI models to assess their capabilities, safety, and helpfulness. Your insights and data will directly inform model development and optimization.

Exact tasks vary by project and will be spelled out in that project's Statement of Work (SOW) before you start. Depending on the role, your work may include:

  • Submitting deliverables (write-ups, ratings, screenshots, or recordings) in the format each task specifies.

✅ What We're Looking For

  • Native or expert-level fluency in Vietnamese, as spoken in Vietnam
  • Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills - assessment maybe required
  • 18 years of age or older
  • Hands-on experience using AI models or large language models
  • Comfortable with both written and voice-based conversation — and good at asking sharp follow-ups
  • Your own smartphone, computer, reliable internet, and comfort with web-based tools
  • Able to pass a language proficiency and technical literacy assessment
  • Responsive communicator — quick replies move you through onboarding faster
  • Able to start within 48 hours

Why PPH? 🌍

🌍 Your language skills are the whole point — and this project pays for them

⚡ Apply once, get contacted directly when a spot opens — no chasing

🏠 Work from anywhere, on your own schedule, alongside any other work you do

🤝 Clear task specs, no ongoing oversight, no micromanagement

💼 Real project experience with a global data and language services company

✨ Work that actually improves how AI understands your language

We started by teaching kids through award-winning programming. We grew into a global data and language services company trusted by clients worldwide. But the mission never changed: keep language alive.

Transcription, translation, localization, linguistic analysis, AI evaluation — it all comes back to preserving languages and the cultures they carry.

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as the trusted technology advisor and single point of contact for one or more key lines of business within the Technology & Operations. This role ensures that the IT strategy, digital initiatives, and technology solutions directly support the CIO/business unit's objectives, compliance requirements, and operational goals. The TAM partners with CIO and multiple Engineering department stakeholders to align technical capabilities to business strategies, facilitate solution delivery, and drive value realization across products and services.

  • Serve as the primary technology liaison between different Engineering pillars and assigned line(s) of business (e.g., Retail Banking, Commercial Lending, Wealth Management, Capital Markets).

  • Understand the LOB’s strategy, processes, regulatory landscape, and technology pain points to guide technical decisions.

  • Partner with CIO/business unit leadership and product owners to develop roadmaps and technology enablement strategies that support business outcomes.

  • Act as a technical advocate and escalation point for service delivery, incident management, and change coordination within the assigned business unit.

  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications and collaborate with different engineering departments, infrastructure, and solution architecture teams to deliver effective solutions.

  • Monitor and report on service performance, compliance adherence, and project status specific to the line of business CIO.

  • Ensure that all implemented solutions follow enterprise security, risk, and compliance frameworks, particularly regarding financial regulations (e.g., SOX, PCI, FINRA, OSFI).

  • Support digital transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, or FinTech integrations relevant to the CIO business domain.

  • Conduct regular health checks and CIO business reviews with stakeholders, identifying opportunities for optimization or innovation.

  • Coordinate cross-functional engineering teams, including vendors and third-party service providers, to ensure end-to-end accountability for solution delivery.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field (Master’s preferred).

  • 5+ years of experience in technical account management, enterprise IT consulting, or solution delivery in the financial services industry.

  • Deep understanding of the financial services domain and one or more LOBs (e.g., banking operations, investment platforms, insurance systems).

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise IT architecture, software development lifecycle, data management, cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), and cybersecurity practices.

  • Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience managing service-level agreements (SLAs), vendor relationships, and IT compliance standards.

  • Strong project management and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

Preferred Skills and Certifications:

  • Certifications: ITIL, PMP, TOGAF, AWS/Azure Certified Solutions Architect, or similar.

  • Familiarity with financial regulations and frameworks (e.g., Basel III, MiFID II, GDPR, SOC 2).

  • Experience with Agile or DevOps methodologies.

Success Metrics:

  • Business satisfaction and trust with IT services.

  • Alignment of technology initiatives to business goals and KPIs.

  • Reduction in service disruptions and technical debt in assigned LOB.

  • Acceleration of digital adoption and time-to-market for business initiatives.

About Flosum

Flosum is a leading B2B SaaS company built 100% natively on the Salesforce platform. We help enterprises manage Salesforce DevOps, Data Migration, Backup & Archive, and Data Masking — all in one secure, compliant platform. Trusted by some of the world's largest and most complex Salesforce organizations, Flosum is bootstrapped, profitable, and growing fast, with 120+ team members and a product roadmap that keeps pace with every Salesforce release.

About the Role

We're hiring a Salesforce Technical Evangelist — the technical face and voice of Flosum to the Salesforce ecosystem. This is a high-visibility role at the intersection of product, marketing, and community. You'll live at the front edge of the Salesforce platform: learning every new release, feature, and architectural shift, then translating it into compelling technical stories for customers, prospects, and the broader community.

You are equal parts technologist, storyteller, and community builder. If you're the person others watch on stage at Dreamin' events, whose webinars people actually attend live, and whose takes on a new Salesforce release get shared across the ecosystem — we want to talk to you.

What You'll Do

  • Own our webinar engine. Plan, host, and deliver a consistent cadence of technical webinars and demos that showcase Flosum solutions and Salesforce best practices — driving registrations, attendance, and pipeline.
  • Evangelize Flosum + Salesforce. Position Flosum as the natural solution for Salesforce DevOps, backup, and data management through demos, talks, blog posts, videos, and social content.
  • Rapidly absorb and teach new technology. Master each Salesforce release (and new Flosum product capabilities) quickly, form a sharp point of view, and communicate it to technical and executive audiences alike.
  • Engage our user community constantly. Build and energize Flosum's user community through ongoing programs — office hours, AMAs, certification support, developer content, and customer advocacy.
  • Connect the channels. Own the connective tissue between webinars, newsletters, and community: promote events, drive newsletter engagement, and keep every channel feeding the others.
  • Represent Flosum in the ecosystem. Engage credibly and technically with the larger Salesforce community — user groups, Dreamin' events, Dreamforce, Trailblazer Community, LinkedIn, and partner ecosystems.
  • Partner across teams. Work with product, marketing, sales, and customer success to surface customer stories, sharpen messaging, and turn community engagement into measurable business outcomes.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 3–7+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience (admin, developer, architect, or consultant), with genuine technical depth — you can demo, build, and go toe-to-toe with a Salesforce architect.
  • Salesforce certifications (e.g., Platform App Builder, Administrator, Developer, or Architect track); an active Trailhead profile is a big plus.
  • A proven track record of public technical communication: webinars hosted, conference talks, podcasts, video content, or a well-followed technical blog/social presence.
  • Strong marketing instincts — you understand audience, messaging, and distribution, and you've driven measurable results (registrations, engagement, pipeline).
  • Deep familiarity with the Salesforce ecosystem: release cycles, DevOps/CI-CD concepts, data management, and the community landscape.
  • Self-starter energy — you build programs from zero, run them on a drumbeat, and don't wait to be told what to create.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Why Flosum

  • Bootstrapped and profitable — we answer to customers, not investors
  • High-visibility role with direct access to the CEO and product leadership
  • A front-row seat to Dreamforce, Salesforce World Tours, and the global ecosystem
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and the freedom to build your personal brand alongside ours

The successful candidate will work alongside Solution Architects, Senior Developers, Functional Consultants, and Project Managers to deliver high-quality Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions. The role involves hands-on development, customization, integration support, troubleshooting, and participation throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within distributed Agile teams are essential.

Key Responsibilities

Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Development

  • Configure and customize Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement applications including Sales, Customer Service, and related solutions.
  • Develop and support:
  • Plugins and custom workflow activities using C# and .NET
  • Client-side scripting using JavaScript and TypeScript
  • Dataverse customizations, business rules, and security configurations
  • Power Automate cloud flows and integrations
  • Model-Driven Apps and Power Platform solutions
  • Participate in solution deployments and environment management activities.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application defects and production issues.
  • Follow established coding standards, development practices, and solution architecture guidelines.

Power Pages Development

  • Develop and maintain Power Pages portals integrated with Dataverse and Dynamics 365.
  • Support:
  • Web templates and page configurations
  • Liquid templates
  • JavaScript customizations
  • Portal security and authentication configurations
  • Assist in improving portal performance, usability, and accessibility.

Azure Integration Support

  • Participate in integration development using:
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure Logic Apps
  • Azure Service Bus
  • Azure Storage
  • REST APIs
  • Assist with troubleshooting and supporting integration solutions.
  • Follow established security and integration best practices.

Project Delivery & Collaboration

  • Participate in Agile delivery teams and sprint activities.
  • Attend backlog grooming, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with:
  • Solution Architects
  • Functional Consultants
  • Project Managers
  • Senior Developers
  • Provide accurate effort estimates for assigned development tasks.
  • Maintain technical documentation and deployment notes.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and reusable development assets.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2–5 years of software development experience.
  • 2+ years of experience working with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement and/or Microsoft Power Platform.
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • C#
  • .NET
  • JavaScript
  • Dataverse
  • Power Automate
  • Model-Driven Apps
  • Understanding of Dynamics 365 customization and configuration concepts.
  • Experience working with source control and development lifecycle processes.
  • Experience working within Agile project teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft certifications in Dynamics 365, Power Platform, or Azure.
  • Experience with:
  • Power Pages
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure Logic Apps
  • Azure Service Bus
  • Azure DevOps
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working for a Microsoft Partner or consulting organization.

raw.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Own the RateHawk.com Selections product strategy, vision, and roadmap, and grow it from a young stream into a mature, measurable business unit.
  • Run the stream as a fast test-and-learn engine: ship experiments, iterate quickly, and turn each result into the next bet. Optimise for speed of learning, not size of upfront plan.
  • Own a continuous pipeline of product opportunities that drive measurable revenue growth, sized from funnel data, content gaps, and user friction.
  • Lead the strategic analysis behind those bets: market and competitor shifts, agent and traveller behaviour, and quantitative plus qualitative research (interviews, usability tests, behavioural analysis) to find root causes and high-leverage problems.
  • Build alignment across Product, Engineering, Commercial, and Operations: sharpen priorities, back decisions with data, and keep everyone moving toward shared goals.
  • Co-own delivery: define clear scope and acceptance criteria, and keep product, engineering, ML, and analytics aligned through to shipped impact.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in Product Management, ideally in travel, marketplace, or content-heavy products.
  • Growth mindset with a track record of scaling a product or stream through experimentation: hypotheses, A/B tests, fast iteration, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong strategic and analytical skills: metric design, SQL, funnel and cohort analysis, and the judgement to turn data into prioritised bets.
  • Bias to action: ships small, learns fast, and improves, rather than waiting for perfect.
  • Enough technical fluency to work with data pipelines, content systems, or ML-driven products, find quick wins, and partner closely with engineering.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional influence; builds trust with engineering, commercial, and operations partners.

Benefits

  • Flexible schedules and opportunity to work remotely.
  • Ambitious and supportive team who love what they do, appreciate each other, and grow together.
  • Internal programs for adaptation and training, development of soft skills, and leadership abilities.
  • Partial compensation for participating in external training and conferences.
  • Corporate English school: Group and individual lessons, speaking clubs with colleagues from all over the world.
  • Corporate prices on hotels and travel services.
  • MyTime Day Off - an extra non-working day without loss of compensation.

raw.description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means.

About Binance Accelerator Program

Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE.

Who may apply

Current university students and recent graduates.
*Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws
We are looking for a motivated Product Data Analyst Intern to join our Product DA team. You will work alongside senior analysts on real product analytics projects — including conversion funnel analysis, A/B experiment evaluation, and dashboard building. This is a hands-on role where you'll gain exposure to product strategy, experiment-driven decision making, and large-scale data infrastructure.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist in building and analyzing user conversion funnels, identifying drop-off points and improvement opportunities
  • Support A/B experiment evaluation: pull experiment data, validate cohort allocation (sanity checks), calculate uplift metrics, and summarize results
  • Build and maintain dashboards for key product metrics (CTR, conversion rate, UV/PV)
  • Respond to product team ad-hoc data requests — user segmentation, feature adoption tracking, campaign performance analysis
  • Write and maintain SQL queries for scheduled data pipelines; assist in data quality monitoring
  • Translate data findings into clear summaries and visualizations for product teams

Requirements:

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's/Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science, or related field)
  • Internship experience in product analytics or related data analysis roles preferred
  • A natural curiosity to identify, investigate and explain trends and patterns in data
  • Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders.
  • Understanding of A/B testing fundamentals (hypothesis testing, p-value, confidence intervals)
  • Strong logical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to work independently
  • Fast learner with curiosity about product strategy and user behavior
  • Competency in one or more of the following:
  • SQL (able to write complex queries with CTEs, window functions, subqueries)
  • Programming (Python/R for data manipulation)
  • A data visualization tool (e.g. DataWind, Tableau, PowerBI)

Nice to Have

  • Experience with event tracking / behavioral analytics (Sensors, Mixpanel, GA)
  • Familiarity with Airflow or data scheduling tools
  • Interest in crypto/fintech industry
  • Prior experience with large-scale data (Hive/Spark environment)
Why Binance
• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)
Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

raw.title: Contracts Administrator
raw.excerpt: Contracts Administrator – Contract Lifecycle Management & Legal OperationsPosition Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.
raw.description:
Contracts Administrator – Contract Lifecycle Management & Legal Operations

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Contracts Administrator to manage the full contract lifecycle — from intake and drafting through approvals, execution, storage, renewals, compliance tracking, and reporting.

This is a highly detail-oriented and process-driven role for someone who understands that effective contract administration is critical to reducing legal, financial, and operational risk.

You’ll work cross-functionally with Legal, Procurement, Finance, Sales, Security, Compliance, and executive stakeholders to ensure agreements move efficiently while remaining accurate, compliant, properly approved, and audit-ready.

What You’ll Own

Contract Intake & Lifecycle Management

  • Manage contract requests including:
    • NDAs
    • MSAs
    • SOWs
    • DPAs
    • Vendor agreements
    • Amendments
    • Renewals
  • Review requests for completeness before initiating contract workflows.
  • Confirm business terms, pricing, counterparties, jurisdictions, and compliance requirements.
  • Route agreements through appropriate review and approval processes.
  • Track contract status and maintain execution timelines against established SLAs.

Contract Drafting, Review & Redlining

  • Draft and format agreements using approved templates and clause libraries.
  • Redline contracts using Microsoft Word Track Changes.
  • Apply approved legal playbooks and fallback language.
  • Identify and escalate non-standard provisions involving:
    • Indemnification
    • Limitation of liability
    • Intellectual property
    • Data privacy and security
    • Termination rights
    • Service-level agreements
  • Maintain clear records of contract deviations, approvals, and rationale.

Approvals & Contract Governance

  • Coordinate contract reviews across:
    • Legal
    • Finance
    • Procurement
    • Information Security
    • Privacy
    • Leadership
  • Verify pricing, budget approvals, vendor documentation, and compliance requirements.
  • Ensure contracts follow established approval matrices and governance policies.
  • Follow up with stakeholders to prevent unnecessary delays.

Execution & Contract Repository Management

  • Manage electronic signature workflows using platforms such as DocuSign or Adobe Sign.
  • Confirm signer authority and signature requirements.
  • Ensure fully executed agreements are properly stored.
  • Maintain accurate records within CLM and contract management platforms such as:
    • Ironclad
    • Icertis
    • Agiloft
    • ContractWorks
    • Conga
    • SharePoint
  • Maintain contract metadata including value, renewal dates, notice periods, jurisdiction, and data-processing requirements.

Renewals, Obligations & Compliance

  • Track:
    • Contract expiration dates
    • Renewal deadlines
    • Auto-renewal provisions
    • Notice periods
    • Pricing escalators
    • Contractual obligations
  • Maintain proactive reminders to prevent missed deadlines.
  • Support compliance requirements involving GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and internal controls.
  • Maintain complete approval, execution, and signature trails for audit readiness.

Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Track and report on:
    • Contract cycle times
    • SLA adherence
    • Renewal pipelines
    • Clause deviations
    • Standard-term usage
  • Improve contract templates, clause libraries, workflows, and documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive contract administration processes.
  • Help develop scalable and self-service contracting workflows.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in contracts administration, contract lifecycle management, legal operations, procurement operations, or a related function.
  • Hands-on experience managing contracts throughout their lifecycle.
  • Experience with CLM systems, contract repositories, and e-signature workflows.
  • Strong proficiency with:
    • Microsoft Word Track Changes
    • Excel or Google Sheets
    • PDF editing tools
  • Working understanding of common contractual provisions including:
    • Indemnification
    • Limitation of liability
    • Confidentiality
    • Intellectual property
    • DPAs
    • SLAs
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple contracts and stakeholders simultaneously.

Nice to Have

  • Experience within SaaS, technology, healthcare, finance, or regulated industries.
  • Familiarity with vendor risk management and procurement workflows.
  • Experience handling security questionnaires.
  • Experience maintaining clause libraries and contract templates.
  • Familiarity with legal playbooks and approval matrices.
  • Exposure to GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOX, or similar compliance frameworks.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely succeed in this role if you:

  • Catch small contractual and documentation inconsistencies quickly.
  • Enjoy structured, process-heavy work.
  • Can manage a high volume of agreements without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Follow deadlines closely and proactively manage renewals.
  • Communicate effectively across legal and non-legal teams.
  • Understand when an issue can follow standard process and when it needs escalation.
  • Take ownership of contracts from initial request through final execution and ongoing management.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include reviewing new contract requests, drafting or redlining agreements, coordinating internal approvals, managing DocuSign workflows, updating CLM records, monitoring upcoming renewals, checking contractual obligations, and preparing contract reporting.

You’ll also work with stakeholders to resolve bottlenecks and continuously improve contracting processes.

In short: you ensure contracts move efficiently while remaining accurate, compliant, properly approved, searchable, and proactively managed throughout their lifecycle.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Contracts executed within SLA timelines.
  • Zero missed renewal or notice deadlines.
  • High contract metadata accuracy.
  • Complete and audit-ready documentation.
  • Reduced contract cycle times.
  • Consistent adherence to approval workflows.
  • Reduced non-standard clause deviations.
  • Strong stakeholder satisfaction with contract operations.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High-impact role supporting critical business operations.
  • Cross-functional exposure to Legal, Finance, Procurement, Compliance, and leadership.
  • Opportunity to improve and scale contract lifecycle processes.
  • Strong ownership over contract governance and operational accuracy.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Legal Operations Manager
    • Contract Manager
    • Procurement Operations
    • Commercial Operations
    • Contract Management Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Practical Task – NDA Redlining Exercise / Contract Tracker Creation
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you have experience in contract administration or legal operations, enjoy managing detailed workflows, and can keep high-volume agreements accurate, compliant, and organized from intake through renewal, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a strong opportunity for someone who excels at contract lifecycle management, legal operations, and process accuracy.

Position Reports to: Senior Director, Consulting
Department: Consulting
Location: US-based remote, with a strong preference for candidates within commutable distance to one of NFF’s Offices (Boston, New York, Philadelphia, Oakland, and Los Angeles)
Salary Range: $66,000 - $70,200

About Nonprofit Finance Fund 

Nonprofit Finance Fund® (NFF®) is a nonprofit lender, consultant, and advocate.Since 1980, we’ve helped organizations access the money and resources they need to realize their communities’ aspirations. Alongside others, we’re working to build community wealth and well-being and put affordable housing, essential services, quality jobs, and excellent education within reach of more people. To learn more, visit nff.org. Learn more about our work to achieve our vision through our Theory of Change and Values. 

About the Role

NFF’s Consulting team works with nonprofit organizations, funders, coalitions, networks and other mission-driven partners to support capacity building and financial sustainability. The team partners with nonprofit leaders navigating growth, change, and systemic challenges by providing strategic advice, financial analysis, and capacity-building support. Through customized consulting engagements nationwide, NFF helps organizations strengthen their capacity, sustainability, and impact.

NFF seeks an Initiative Support Associate to strengthen project execution operational effectiveness and client service delivery within the Consulting Department. The Associate will partner closely with consulting staff to coordinate projects and initiatives, maintain accurate project information, track progress against key milestones, and support the operational processes that underpin high quality consulting engagements. While this role is grounded in project coordination and department operations, the Associate will work across teams to facilitate communication, organize information, support compliance and invoicing requirements, and ensure critical project data and documentation remain current and accessible. The Associate will also assist with the review and analysis of client materials, including financial statements and impact data, helping project teams effectively manage information and advance client engagements.

NFF has offices in Boston, New York, Philadelphia, Oakland, and Los Angeles. This is a US-based remote role, with a strong preference for candidates within commutable distance to one of NFF’s offices. NFF has core business hours where we expect all staff to be available from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm local time, and occasional travel (20%) is required.

What You Will Do

Essential responsibilities for this role include, but are not limited to:

Project Coordination & Execution Support (40%) 

  • Coordinate project logistics and maintain project plans, action item trackers, timelines, deliverables, and other tools that support effective project execution
  • Support client-facing administrative processes, including report timelines, invoicing and billing, tracking re-grant disbursements, and coordinating documentation with internal and external partners
  • Prepare meeting materials, agendas, notes, and follow-up communications 
  • Monitor assigned tasks and proactively communicate progress, risks, and support needs 
  • Contribute to high quality client deliverables, including PowerPoint presentations, engagement letters, research reports, and workshop/training curriculum
  • Identify opportunities for improvements; recommend policy or process changes as appropriate

Research, Analysis & Deliverable Development (25%) 

  • Update and maintain Salesforce data, ensuring financial, impact, and project records are accurate, organized, and current
  • Conduct research and gather information from a variety of sources to support consulting engagements 
  • Compile, organize, and analyze quantitative and qualitative data 
  • Support the development of presentations, reports, summaries, and other client-facing deliverables 
  • Synthesize information into clear findings, observations, and recommendations 
  • Review work products for accuracy, consistency, and completeness prior to delivery 

Knowledge Management & Continuous Learning (15%) 

  • Identify recurring themes, trends, and insights across projects, clients, and engagements 
  • Contribute to development and maintenance of tools, templates, resources, and knowledge repositories 
  • Support efforts to capture lessons learned and effective practices from consulting engagements 
  • Share observations and emerging insights that may strengthen future project design and delivery 

Client & Team Support (10%) 

  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across projects to support successful engagement outcomes 
  • Participate in client and internal meetings, contributing notes, follow-up actions, and logistical support 
  • Lead event logistics and support the delivery of client-facing workshops, training sessions, and convenings, including scheduling, participant coordination, materials preparation, and virtual or in-person execution
  • Build positive working relationships with clients, partners, and colleagues 
  • Seek feedback, clarification, and guidance to ensure alignment with project goals and expectations. 
  • Contribute to a collaborative, inclusive, and solutions-oriented team environment 

Meetings and Other Duties as Assigned (10%) 

  • Participate in department, team, and organizational meetings 
  • Engage in professional development and learning opportunities 
  • Support special projects, initiatives, and organizational priorities as assigned 
  • Contribute to NFF as a learning organization that seeks to advance the sector
  • Perform other duties consistent with the scope and level of the position 

Who You Are and Minimum Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution or equivalent combinations of relevant education, training, and experience 
  • One (1) year of professional work experience 
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain strong attention to detail 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills 
  • Demonstrated analytical, research, and problem-solving skills 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook 
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively within a team environment 

The Strongest Candidates Will 

  • Be committed to NFF’s values, mission, and approach to community impact  
  • Bring experience in nonprofit, public sector, consulting, financial services, or related environments 
  • Understand or be eager to learn about CDFIs and community-centered finance  
  • Build strong, trust-based relationships and collaborate effectively across teams, geographies, and perspectives in a highly matrixed organization 
  • Be able to work with large amounts of data to independently create reports and presentations
  • Work independently, communicate proactively, and take ownership of outcomes 
  • Demonstrate curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning and professional growth 
  • Thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment where priorities evolve and ambiguity is common 

Benefits and Compensation 

NFF offers a generous benefits package that currently includes up to twenty (20) paid holidays/business closure days, three (3) floating holidays, flexible time off, group medical insurance with a funded health reimbursement account, dental and vision plans, life insurance and disability plans, a retirement plan with both a non-elective employer contribution (4%) and additional match contribution (up to 2%), a “work from home” fund, and flexible spending accounts to cover health, dependent care, and commuter costs.

This is a full-time role with a compensation range of $66,000 - $70,200. A compensation offer is based on a candidate’s background and years of relevant experience, with consideration for internal equity. Because of our strong commitment to equity and growth, we do not negotiate compensation offers.

We’re looking for our next Channel Champion to join the team as Head of Revenue Operations!

About Channelscaler

Channelscaler is transforming how companies scale through their partners.Our AI-powered platform automates and simplifies partner engagement — from onboarding and incentives to performance tracking — helping vendors and partners grow faster together.

With one unified system, companies manage their entire partner lifecycle with ease and clarity. We’re building a category-defining company rooted in expertise, empathy, and innovation — and we’re just getting started.

About the Role

As the Head of Revenue Operations, reporting to the VP of Finance, you’ll own the systems, data, and forecasting discipline that our executive team and board rely on to run the business.

This is a build role. You’llestablish the forecasting rigor, reporting standards, and data foundation a company at our stage needs to operate predictably, and you’ll partner across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Finance to make those standards hold.

You’ll own the weekly forecast process outright and hold a standing seat in board reporting, quarterly business reviews, and annual planning. This role is central to how Channelscaler plans, measures, and defends its revenue performance.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll focus on delivering results that move both the team and company forward by:

  • Own forecasting and planning, including the weekly forecast, pipeline review cadence, and the reforecast standards senior leadership and investors rely on.
  • Build a single, trusted source of revenue truth across ARR, pipeline, and retention reporting that reconciles to Finance and holds up to board scrutiny.
  • Instrument retention economics, including net and gross revenue retention, renewal forecasting, churn cohorts, and expansion, so leakage surfaces early enough to act on.
  • Own the GTM technology roadmap (Salesforce, HubSpot, Salesloft, DealHub, and related tools), the data governance behind it.
  • Design pricing, segmentation, and territory strategy grounded in ICP, and implement it in the CRM.
  • Identify and lead efficiency gains through AI and automation, from scoring and forecasting models to workflow design across the revenue stack.
  • Deliver executive and board materials, including board reviews, strategic planning, and QBRs, and coach the revenue operations talent around you.

What Success Looks Like

  • Forecast accuracy sustained within an agreed variance band across consecutive quarters.
  • One trusted ARR data set, reportable by product and segment, that Finance and GTM both stand behind.
  • Retention reporting that surfaces churn and expansion drivers early enough to change the outcome.
  • Quotas, segmentation, and performance objectivesimplemented on time ahead of each fiscal year.
  • A documented, governed GTM stack with every system in a company-managed tenant and access that can be audited.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 7+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, or business operations within B2B SaaS.
  • Must have hands-on experience standing up revenue operations in an unstructured or early-stage environment, including creating the processes, systems, and reporting infrastructure where little or none existed before. Candidates whose experience is limited to running a mature, already-functioning RevOps organization will not be a fit.
  • A track record owning a forecast that senior leadership and investors relied on, with a clear view of how you made it credible.
  • Depth in revenue systems architecture and data governance across CRM and marketing automation.
  • Proven ability to influence Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance without direct authority over them.

Core Competencies:

  • Systems thinking. You reason about the business first and the tooling second.
  • Ruthless prioritization. There will always be more RevOpswork here than capacity, and you decide what matters.
  • Data fluency. Comfortable in SQL and BI tools, not only CRM reporting.
  • Cross-functional credibility. You move teams you do not own.
  • Accountability. You quantify your own impact and own what did not work.

Preferred (nice to have):

  • Retention and expansion analytics in a partner, channel, or ecosystem context.
  • Applying AI or LLM tooling to scoring, forecasting, or GTM analytics.
  • Business intelligence, analytics, and data science experience.
  • M&A, carve-out, or post-acquisition integration experience

Location & Work Environment

Channelscaler is a remote-first company with team members across the U.S., Ireland, India, and the U.K. For this role, we prefer candidates based in the Eastern Standard Time zone. Minimal travel expected (10 - 15% annually).

What We Offer

We thrive in a collaborative, growth-oriented environment that values curiosity and ownership.

  • Competitive base salary and performance-based bonus or commission (where applicable)
  • 25 days of paid time off annually
  • 12 dedicated training days per year for professional development
  • Paid parental leave
  • Health insurance (PPO and HSA plan options)
  • 401(k) match
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible hours
  • Annual team offsites and opportunities for in-person collaboration

Equal Opportunity Employer

Channelscaler is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that diverse teams create better outcomes. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, including those with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or perform the essential functions of the job, please contact .

Salary: $150,000 - $175,000 USD

raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.What this opportunity involves:
We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 8+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paidEffort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 30 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation:
Up to $200/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~30 hours each; you set your own schedule.
